coverage_gap.note: changed web page.tsx while carrying backend-only checks; introduced the type predicate later reported as F19

findings.summary: Deployment kit proxies container loopback and binds gateway to host loopback, contradicting the approved Docker Caddy-to-host 172.20.0.1:8790 topology; all public API access fails.
Required local E2E command exits 1: forced failure never reaches fake Telegram. Harness does not isolate/seed the separate authoritative retry-context read used by production events.
First-install runbook restarts the gateway before installing its unit and starts a tunnel without instructions to start/configure the laptop remote API listener.
Gateway request logger mistakes the full HTTP request line for status and logs OAuth code/state query values.
GET logout mutates sessions without Origin/header checks; POST guard accepts arbitrary nonempty X-Flow-Request values instead of requiring 1.
Telegram task retry pins run state, while the real laptop compares task state, causing valid failed-task retries to be rejected as stale.
Advertised note command is accepted by the web/gateway but has no laptop dispatcher and returns COMMAND_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
Phone brief editor omits the required task, offers no criteria edit, hides editing on launched plans, and uses plan-state preconditions against an active run-state reader.
Run-level reopen form sends no task although the laptop reopen dispatcher requires params.task, so Reabrir ejecucion fails.
Ordinary plans waiting for approval emit no plan.waiting event unless they also have a scheduler decision request.
Gateway restart loses offline snapshots/read caches and resets SSE sequence IDs, suppressing new events behind an old Last-Event-ID without resynchronization.
Gateway SSE history, notification outbox/history and abandoned expired sessions grow without bounded retention or the promised 90-day history pruning.
Failed probes overwrite snapshot cachedAt, there is no stable offlineSince, and the web omits the required outage-start time.
Laptop remote failure-review redaction recognizes only four credential names; synthetic provider API key assignments and bearer authorization text reach the control plane unchanged.
T9 socket-preserving reload is absent: stale server is terminated/restarted and serve creates a new listening socket.
Web discards unknown-outcome command envelopes and generates a new idempotency key on each retry, with no same-key reconciliation/retry path.
Published command schema describes the gateway envelope as the laptop body, disagrees on key length, and omits answer-decision and the required round selector.
The prior Caddy container-loopback upstream defect is corrected in the supplied prerequisite tree.
The E2E fixture still yields no failure event and its supposedly valid cancel command pins running against a reserved attempt; full E2E also stops at the web build.
Runbook still omits installing/configuring the private laptop API and reverse tunnel; public Caddy hostname remains an unexplained placeholder.
Request logging still writes OAuth code/state query values into the status field.
GET logout bypasses mutation guards, and the CSRF marker accepts any nonempty value rather than 1.
Telegram retry and alert action/deep-link integration are missing; the previous bad retry envelope was removed rather than repaired.
The advertised note command remains accepted by validators but has no laptop dispatcher.
Task brief editing now supplies the task and run precondition, but the phone still cannot edit acceptance criteria.
Run-level Reabrir ejecución still sends no task to a dispatcher that requires one.
An ordinary plan waiting for approval still emits no plan.waiting event without a scheduler decision.
Restart still loses the cached snapshot and resets SSE IDs without a resynchronization protocol.
Gateway event history, delivered/dropped outbox/history and abandoned expired sessions remain unbounded.
Failed probes relabel cached data with the current time; offline start time is not exposed to the phone.
Laptop redaction still misses provider API-key assignments and bearer authorization text before transmission.
The earlier absence of an inherited-listener path is corrected in the supplied prerequisite tree.
The web still discards unknown-outcome envelopes and generates a fresh key on every retry.
Published command/event schemas still disagree with production dialects, field names and key limits.
Browser checks still share Next.js output/configuration, and serial execution now reveals a stale answer-round contract assertion.
The current run-history parser does not typecheck, preventing the production build and every built-web E2E scenario.
Successful real OAuth sessions cannot load the phone panel because the gateway and web disagree on the session response.
The real phone feed cannot connect or decode production events despite mock SSE coverage.
Filling the required env-example values still leaves blank optional settings that prevent gateway startup.
Phone command history drops the stored web/telegram origin and displays target/command in its place.
Caddy used container loopback instead of the host Docker bridge upstream.
The required built-web E2E still fails: its forced-failure fixture produces no failure event or notification.
The runbook restarts an uninstalled gateway unit on first install and reloads host Caddy although the approved service is containerized.
Gateway request logging exposes OAuth code/state query values in its purported status field.
The mutation marker accepts arbitrary nonempty values, and GET logout clears the cookie without guards or revoking its server session.
Telegram alerts still omit a working review URL and safe inline actions, and retry callbacks remain unsupported.
The public note command is still advertised and validated without a laptop dispatcher.
The phone brief form still cannot edit acceptance criteria.
Run-level Reabrir ejecución supplies no task identity to a task-scoped operation.
Ordinary plans waiting for approval previously emitted no plan.waiting event without a scheduler decision.
Gateway restart loses the last cached snapshot and restarts SSE IDs without a reset/resynchronization protocol.
Gateway event replay memory, delivered/dropped outbox history and abandoned expired sessions remain unbounded.
The stable cachedAt repair remains, but no stable offline-start timestamp reaches the phone.
Laptop-side redaction previously missed provider-key assignments and bearer authorization text before transmission.
The local panel previously had no inherited systemd listener implementation.
The phone still discards unknown-outcome command envelopes and creates a fresh idempotency key on resubmission.
The public command schema still disagrees with production commands and key limits; event target normalization has been repaired.
The required browser verification previously failed and asserted obsolete singular round answers.
The integrated phone app previously failed strict typing and production build due to overlapping implementations.
The phone previously rejected the real gateway's successful {login:'dav033'} session response.
The phone still opens an SSE route the production gateway does not serve and does not resume using its replay IDs.
The earlier env-startup allegation assumed blank optional settings despite the current runbook requiring every uncommented key to be filled.
Overlapping phone command-history implementations previously broke compilation and mislabeled origin.
Installed planning-command preconditions previously failed because bt_remote_preconditions was absent from distributions.
The failed-task link previously opened only an unrelated static review fixture.
Rejected failure review is now reachable, but authoritative rejected tasks still cannot be recovered from the phone.
Command rate limits remain shared by owner login across sessions rather than per session as R17 specifies.
The command ledger checks preconditions before its effect lock and accepts a second concurrently stale command.
Production snapshots omit the timestamp fields the phone uses for last signal of life and discard plan detail/revision metadata.
Stalled-attempt notifications start after 15 minutes although the specification requires more than 10 minutes.
An already authenticated SSE connection continues to deliver after the session expires.
Every phone pinned-retry command is rejected because the gateway forwards a route object to a laptop validator requiring string selectors.

source: REQ-027 T18 audit ledgers (remote/docs/audit.findings.json) at three accepted-audit snapshots; sanitized: ids, severities, owner tasks and the first 240 characters of each summary, no logs or secrets
